Throw

Medium Armor

Heavy Armor

Lift

Lifts and suspends enemies in the air, so they are unable to move or attack

Master Lift

Garrus told you about his encounter with Dr. Saleon, the geneticist. He regrets letting him escape the first time and hopes that you'll be able to track him down and bring him to justice.
Garrus: Find Dr. Saleon
Garrus gave the coordinates of Dr. Saleon's last known whereabouts. Head to the Herschel System in the Kepler Verge.
Head to Coordinates
You've boarded the MSV Fedele, see if Dr. Saleon is on board.
Find Dr. Saleon

You found Dr. Saleon and killed him. Whatever sick experiments he was conducting are now over. Garrus was disappointed that he didn't get to finish what he started, but he seemed to understand why did it.
Garrus: Dr. Saleon is Dead
You found Dr. Saleon and Garrus killed him. Whatever sick experiments he was conducting are now over. Garrus seems relieved now that it's over and Dr. Saleon is no longer free to cause havoc.

You found Dr. Saleon and tried to arrest him, but died trying to fight you off. Whatever sick experiments he was conducting are now over. Garrus seems relieved now that it's over and Dr. Saleon is no longer free to cause havoc.
You found Dr. Saleon and killed him. Whatever sick experiments he was conducting are now over. Garrus was not with you and he'll likely be upset he wasn't there to finish off Saleon himself.

DISCOVERY
This cluster of prefab utility shacks have a distinctly ramshackle look to them. A set of rover tracks lead away over the mountain ridge to the southwest.
Abandoned Mining Camp

DISCOVERY
The front of the rover is crumpled in from impact. A glance inside tells you the occupants - probably a team of illegal "wildcat" miners - are dead. Debris is still sliding down the furrows left by its tires, silent in the near-vacuum atmosphere.
Crashed Mining Vehicle
After to talking to Wrex you learned that he's looking for his family's ceremonial armor. It was taken by the turians after the Krogan Rebellion and now a profiteer named Tonn Actus has it.
Wrex: Family Armor
You found a krogan armor belonging to the Urdnot Clan while exploring the planet Tuntau. It appears to very old and perhaps very valuable.
Wrex was very happy that you recovered his armor. Apparently it's not very good, but it does have sentimental value. Well... sentimental for a krogan.
Find the turian who stole Wrex's family armor. He's hiding at a base somewhere in the Argos Rho cluster.
Find Wrex's Armor
You've discovered armor belonging to a krogan from the Urdnot clan. There was krogan back on the Citadel called Urdnot Wrex. Maybe he knows something about this.
Find the Owner of this Armor
Give Armor to Wrex
Wrex must know something about the armor you found on Tuntau. Talk to him and see what he can tell you about it.
You found armor that belongs to the Urdnot Clan. The only krogan you knew with that name is dead and gone. Wrex won't be needing this anytime soon.
You found krogan armor belonging to the Urdnot Clan. If Wrex was still alive he could probably tell you more about it.

Barrier

Adds a biotic barrier to your shield that absorbs damage, but cannot block attacks that bypass shields

Advanced Barrier

Increases the amount of damage Barier absorbs, allows you to use Barrier for a longer duration and more often

Master Barrier

Stasis

Advanced Stasis

Master Stasis

Master Unity

While on the Citadel you uncovered an Alliance patrol report. One of the patrols mentioned some strange activity in the Hydra System of the Argos Rho cluster.
Unusual Readings
Go to the Hydra System in the Argos Rho cluster and investigate.
Investigate System
PAUSED
Mining Camp

DISCOVERY
It appears these particle bores were shut down after breaking through into tunnels just below the surface.

The shacks and equipment are stenciled with the logo of the Tenkarra Mining Consortium, but there is no trace of the mining crew.

The logs for the freighter on Feros showed large deliveries being made to a system in the Voyager cluster. The strange thing is, there's nothing out that way that would warrant such a demand for supplies.
Investigate Shipments
Head to the Amazon system in the Voyager cluster and investigate.
Go to Amazon System
You discovered a strange transmission discussing some sort of biotic commune. On the whole it seems harmless, but something about the message is a little disturbing.
Strange Transmission
Head to the Century System in the Hawking Eta cluster and investigate the strange biotic commune.
Find the Commune
Geth Communications Array
You found a confidential transmission while on Feros. It's unclear exactly what's going on, but it appears ExoGeni sent some kind of sample to a research facility on Nodacrux.
Investigate Facility
Nodacrux is located in the Vostok system of the Maroon Sea Cluster. Head there and find out what's going on.
Turn Off Geth Comm

DISCOVERY
The geth array is transmitting regular data bursts on an encrypted channel, using the Alliance's own FTL comm buoys. It's not clear where the data is being directed, nor the content of the signal.
While on Feros you found the personal log of an ExoGeni employee. The doctor's notes seem to express some concern about samples they provided to a group he referred to only as Cerberus.
Investigate Samples
The logs mentioned something about the Matano system, in the Maroon Sea cluster. That would be a good place to start your investigation.
Go to System

While on Noveria, you found a log listing an unauthorized transmission. Apparently someone thinks a doctor located in the Newton system is in grave danger. Unfortunately, it appears the message was intercepted by Noveria security before it could be delivered.
Doctor at Risk
Head to the Newton system in the Kepler Verge and warn the doctor.
Find the Doctor
While on Noveria you found something interesting in Tartakovsky's personal log files. He mentioned increased mercenary activity in the Artemis Tau cluster, specifically in the Macedon system.
Mercenaries
Head to the Macedon system in the Artemis Tau cluster and investigate the mercenary attacks.
Investigate Mercenaries
According a log file you uncovered on Noveria, an entire colony has gone missing from the Hades Gamma cluster.
Missing Colony
Go to the Antaeus system in the Hades Gamma cluster and determine what's happened to the survey team.
Investigate Situation

DISCOVERY
This massive skull is scored by deflected mass accelerator shots. The xenobiology files in your hardsuit computer can't identify the species. It must have been brought here from an unknown world.
Strange Skull
Files from an encrypted geth terminal indicated that the geth may be amassing a large fighting force in the Armstrong Cluster. If true, this could be the precursor to a full on war with the geth.
Geth Activities
